training: none locally; evaluate released RLinf MetaWorld PPO FlowNoise fine-tuned checkpoint frozen
benchmark: MT1 for each v3 task, 20 distinct reset configurations sampled without replacement from 50 train_tasks
action: official unnormalized 4D action; no residual controller or scripted expert
numerics: reference BF16 with selected FP32 parameters; inference only
execution: eager PyTorch via TORCH_COMPILE_DISABLE=1 to bound extra memory beside existing training
retry_policy: infrastructure errors are logged, do not count as task failures, and retry the same episode seed; max 2 restarts per worker
comparability: paired v3 environment, same task configurations, seeds and rollout limits; only checkpoint switched
environment_seeding: Farama v3 native reset(seed=...) is ignored; call env.seed(episode_seed) before reset
integrity: Record full before/after observations for audit only; abort simulation exceptions; independently validate success flags, returns, seeds, task IDs and artifact SHA256
model_selection: official RLinf pi0 MetaWorld RL FlowNoise checkpoint; selected from published π0 MT50 variants before this run, not tuned to five tasks
reward_function_version: Farama 3.1.1 defaults; the cited MTBench April 2026 PPO reward patch is a separate Isaac Gym environment
